$comment: Rhythm/position/motion/asset rules JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule names the function that enforces it; extraction/verify_all.py::check_graph_validator_agreement asserts each named function exists and that every derived set still equals what templates.json says.

REAL_SAME_CATEGORY_PAIRS.derivedBy: adjacent nodes of templates.json -> home whose sections share a category

rules.rule: A PageSpec's nodes[] must match, in order, the node list of the template its 'template' field DECLARES (required/repeatable honoured). Cross-references the declared template; never inspects nodes[] in isolation.
A route other than the template's measured routes ('/' for home) is allowed -- a generated page may live elsewhere -- but is FLAGGED, because only '/' was measured.
shell.nav must be node 0.
shell.footer must be the last node.
hero.split-visual (constraints.mustImmediatelyFollow) sits immediately after shell.nav.
proof.testimonial sits immediately after proof.results-stats: they share one container and one component (Results.jsx).
conversion.demo-form sits immediately before shell.footer: both are inside the one <footer> element (Footer.jsx).
conversion.faq sits immediately before conversion.demo-form (the last objections are answered right before the ask).
Exactly one hero-category node, unless the template is in derivedSets.NO_HERO_TEMPLATES.
rules.exception: derivedSets.NO_HERO_TEMPLATES is EMPTY: the only template has a hero. Derived from the node sequence, so it cannot silently diverge from the validator.

rules.rule: Every section here is onePerPage (no section legitimately repeats on the real page, so no (section, variant) keying is needed).
Two adjacent nodes of the same category are flagged, except the pairs that are adjacent on the real page.
rules.exception: REAL AND REQUIRED: the IA categories put 5 same-category pairs next to each other on the only real page (three product modules in a row, stats+testimonial, statement+quote, faq+demo-form). They are derived from the node sequence (derivedSets.REAL_SAME_CATEGORY_PAIRS), so the rule cannot reject the real page.

rules.rule: motion.pattern must be in the section's allowedPatterns. There is no generic scroll fade-in pattern: sections do not fade in on scroll.
Every node declares reducedMotionFallback, equal to the section contract's const. Required for generated pages even though the source implements none.
Optional motion.trigger / durationMs / delayMs / easing must be values MEASURED for that pattern in tokens/00-foundation/motion.json (a value valid for another pattern is rejected).
Every media object's assetRole is in the closed enum AND in that field's own allowed roles; roles with exposedAsPageSpecField:false never appear.
assetRef is accepted only for may-generate-new roles; must-not-reuse / must-not-fabricate roles render a neutral placeholder and carry no file reference.
No string anywhere in a PageSpec may reference /assets/, public/assets/ or an http(s) URL.
The nine real-third-party roles hold their exact pinned generationPolicy in assets/asset-roles.json and the allowlist.
No PageSpec string may contain the original brand/assistant names or the real third-party names listed in assets/asset-roles.json -> bannedTerms. Copy must be original placeholder copy.
conversion.demo-form.form.live is const false; no action/endpoint/method/portalId/formId/hubspot field may appear anywhere in a PageSpec.
Video fields carry no embed/iframe/autoplay/youtube field: the video is a static placeholder making no network request.
Every linkPhrases / boldPhrases entry occurs verbatim in its sibling text.
Every text field respects its maxWords budget, per instance.
